items.title: Kenya's Public Broadcaster Violated Employees' Privacy with Mandatory Facial Recognition Attendance, Court Found
items.summary: Kenya's High Court found that the state-owned Kenya Broadcasting Corporation unlawfully collected employees' facial biometrics for mandatory attendance without informed consent or a prior data protection impact assessment. items.searchText: oof-aii-884401 york county, south carolina, deputies reportedly held local motorist at gunpoint after flock safety license-plate reader misread steven melvin, a 42-year-old york county, south carolina, motorist was reportedly detained at gunpoint for more than five minutes after a flock safety automated license-plate reader misidentified the first letter of his plate and matched his bmw to a similar stolen vehicle. the sheriff’s office later said an illegal tinted plate cover caused the malfunction and found the deputy’s actions “reasonable”; flock said alerts should be independently verified before enforcement. united states of america surveillance technology, flock safety automated license plate reader system, automated license plate readers (alpr) aig® - governance architecture asga™ — autonomous systems governance architecture
